## Description

Export security/audit events to the hospital SIEM (no PHI), quarterly privileged access review, security evidence pack (pen test, controls, ADHICS/ISO mappings, DR results).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Hospital SIEM receives the agreed event stream.
- [ ] **AC2.** Privileged access review completed and recorded.
- [ ] **AC3.** Security evidence pack delivered.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
